summary: Lake County, MT Flathead NF lookout: a 30-ft L-4 tower built 1934 and since removed; a 1940 federal survey describes the lookout house.

facts.status_note: Both sources list the tower as removed; no removal date given

events.note: Firelookout.com: 30-foot pole L-4 tower built in 1934
Coast and Geodetic Survey described the lookout house in 1940 and recorded its condition as good
August 5, 1951 Daily Inter Lake item places a fire about one mile east of Cedar lookout; the item does not say the lookout watched it

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Both lookout pages call the site Cedar Point; the NGS survey station is named CEDAR LOOKOUT. The record keeps Cedar Point; the survey name is the same peak.

notes_for_editor: Brief height_m was null; the 30-foot pole height from firelookout.com gives 9.1 m and is added to facts. The NGS station position (47 40 04.93 N, 113 56 13.87 W, NAD 83) is about 50 m from the record coordinates, which supports the location. The Forest Lookouts page gives 22N-18W-17 as its location; not checked against other records. Removal date and cause are not given in any source read, and no source describes the site today or public access. The 1951 item shows only that the lookout was still used as a landmark, not that it was staffed. Two web searches found no other Cedar Point lookout in Montana.
